- Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares

assessments.reasoning: The survey questionnaire (epacues21.pdf) does not include a domestic or care work module separate from the main questionnaire. Unpaid domestic and care activities are instead recorded as categories of inactivity ('Dedicado a las labores del hogar' in section H) or as reasons for not seeking or working full-time ('Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares' in section D and section C).
